summary: The Address bar arrow button (go button) has a misleading tooltip pointing to a URL when it may be searching
description:
My machine(s) have DNS set up such that it would search for certain domains implicitly. This is done by  tailscale, so that instead of having to type `hostname.tailnet` I can type `hostname` and have it resolve to other nodes in the tailnet.

On firefox when I type just the `hostname` and press Enter, it will by default search for this in a search engine. I get it, its a heuristic, as `hostname` isn't sufficiently domain-like for firefox to attempt to resolve that name. This is fine.

However, if I hover over an arrow that appears at the end of the address bar as I begin typing, the tooltip says: “Go to the address in the location bar”, but instead of navigating to `http(s)://hostname` it *still* searches for `hostname` on a search engine!

That sounds like a broken button to me!
